title: Anchoring Adversarial Trajectories to Data Manifolds: A Bilevel Transfer Optimization Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.38991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A key bottleneck in adversarial transfer is a trajectory-level geometric disconnect: ambient gradients often drift away from the intrinsic data manifold, causing surrogate-specific overfitting. To rectify this, we propose Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer (MABT), a unified framework that anchors adversarial trajectories to the shared semantic subspace. MABT introduces a relaxed manifold-anchoring operator as a semantic rectifier to suppress off-manifold noise. With this constraint, we cast transfer attack generation as a distributional bilevel optimization problem that learns a geometry-aligned initialization by minimizing expected transfer risk under a surrogate uncertainty distribution. We further develop a Hessian-free solver with linear-time complexity to handle the resulting hierarchy. translated_title: 将对抗轨迹锚定到数据流形：一个双层迁移优化框架
translated_abstract: 对抗迁移的一个关键瓶颈是轨迹层面的几何脱节：环境梯度常常偏离内在数据流形，导致针对替代模型的过拟合。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了流形锚定双层迁移（Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer, MABT），这是一个将对抗轨迹锚定到共享语义子空间的统一框架。MABT 引入了一个松弛的流形锚定算子作为语义矫正器，以抑制流形外的噪声。在这一约束下，我们将迁移攻击生成转化为一个分布式的双层优化问题，通过在替代模型不确定性分布下最小化期望迁移风险来学习几何对齐的初始化。我们进一步开发了一个具有线性时间复杂度的无 Hessian 求解器来处理由此产生的层级结构。实验表明，在 28 种攻击配置、多样的受害模型架构和防御设置下，10 个基线攻击方法的可迁移性均得到了提升。
tldr: 该论文提出流形锚定双层迁移框架 MABT，通过将对抗轨迹锚定到共享数据流形并将迁移攻击生成建模为分布双层优化问题，配合线性时间复杂度的无 Hessian 求解器，显著提升了对抗样本的迁移攻击能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MABT, a framework that anchors adversarial trajectories to shared data manifolds and formulates transfer attack generation as a distributional bilevel optimization problem, solved by a linear-time Hessian-free solver to significantly improve adversarial transferability.
